title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.105.0, contain a Least Privilege… (CVE-2026-111516)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.105.0 contain a Least Privilege Violation vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially elevate their privileges and cause a denial of service. The vulnerability impacts confidentiality minimally but can severely affect integrity and availability.
